business_summary: CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. provides professional consulting services in Japan, Asia, the United Kingdom, Europe, and internationally. The company offers professional consulting services related to civil engineering and construction works, such as planning, research, design, and supervision services; disaster countermeasures for floods, droughts, tsunamis, and storm surges; watershed hydrology; seismic countermeasures for river management and coastal protection facilities; port and marine infrastructure; and mechanical and electrical equipment. It is also involved in the planning and design of new dams; provision of solutions for existing dams; sediment disaster countermeasures, including disaster surveys and forecasts; planning, design, and maintenance of erosion control facilities, such as check dams and stream protection works; non-mechanical measures; design of pipes, drains, and related facilities; evaluation of the seismic performance of related structures; design of aseismic reinforcement works; detection of structural degradation; and formulation of asset management plans. In addition, the company plans and designs mechanical equipment for weirs, floodgates, locks, sluice pipes and gates, floodwall gates, and drainage pump stations in river systems; dam discharge facilities; and water treatment facilities for water supply and sewerage systems. Further, it provides traffic planning and operation, and logistics business plans; planning and designing of bridges; regional transportation systems, district transportation plans, and support for transportation projects; information and telecommunications technology, disaster mitigation, environment, and geo-environment services; public procurement assistance; and construction and execution management services. The company was formerly known as Kensetsu Gijyutsu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. in February 1964. The company was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: CTI Engineering Co., Ltd.는 일본, 아시아, 영국, 유럽 및 국제적으로 전문 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 기획, 연구, 설계, 감리 서비스 등 토목 및 건축 공사와 관련된 전문 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 홍수, 가뭄, 쓰나미, 폭풍 해일에 대한 재해 대책; 유역 수문학; 하천관리 및 해안보호시설에 대한 지진대책 항구 및 해양 기반 시설; 기계 및 전기 장비. 또한 새로운 댐의 계획 및 설계에도 참여합니다. 기존 댐에 대한 솔루션 제공; 재해 조사 및 예측을 포함한 토사 재해 대책; 점검 댐, 하천 보호 공사 등 사방 시설의 계획, 설계 및 유지 관리; 비기계적 조치; 파이프, 배수구 및 관련 시설의 설계; 관련 구조물의 내진 성능 평가; 내진 보강 공사 설계; 구조적 저하 감지; 자산관리계획 수립 그 밖에도 둑, 수문, 수문, 수문관 등의 기계설비를 기획, 설계하고 있습니다.
